stem: Loyalty members spend €30 a month more than non-members. Within frequent shoppers the gap is €3, and within occasional shoppers €2. Most members are frequent shoppers. What explains most of the €30 gap?

options.text: Who joins: frequent shoppers join more often and spend more anyway
The loyalty scheme itself, which adds about €30 a month per member
Occasional shoppers, because their gap is the smallest
Rounding in the segment averages, which adds up across segments
